name: Nemesis

skills.name: Victory Portent
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 9 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% attack to them.

skills.name: Enlightened Star
skills.description: Select 1 enemy target within 9 tiles of the user and deal Physical damage equal to 130% of attack. When attacking near Cover, increases damage dealt by 20% and gain 2 points of Confectance Index.

skills.name: Penetrating Casket
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 9 tiles, applies Defense Down II for 1 turn, and deals Physical damage equal to 130% of attack to them.

skills.name: Constellation Pursuit
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 9 tiles, dealing Corrosion damage equal to 170% of attack. For each additional 1 point of Confectance Index, this attack's damage is increased by 10%.

skills.name: Remote Observation
skills.description: At the start of the action, marks the 2 nearest enemy targets within range with Prophecy of Mourning for 1 turn. Action Support deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack and 2 points of Stability Damage. This unit gains Insight for 1 turn after using a Action Support.

fortification.effect: Increases the duration of Prophecy of Mourning by 1 turn.
If the target has Prophecy of Mourning, increase damage dealt by 10%.
Gains 1 point of Confectance Index if the target has a defense debuff.
When this unit is under the effects of Insight, further increases damage dealt by 10%.
When Insight is active, increases the damage multiplier by 10%.
For each debuff on the target, increases critical rate by 20%, up to 100%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Potent Curse
keys.effect: If the enemy target is marked with Prophecy of Mourning, apply Defense Down II before launching an active attack.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Changing Fortune
keys.effect: When this unit is under the effects of Insight, the range of the active skills Enlightened Star and Penetrating Casket are increased by 1 tile.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Fortune's Call
keys.effect: If there is Cover nearby while under the effects of Insight, reduce AoE damage taken by 20%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Silent Catastrophe
keys.effect: When killing a target marked with Prophecy of Mourning, gain Attack Up I and Damage Up I for 1 turn.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Fated Calamity
keys.effect: When a target marked with Prophecy of Mourning is killed by this unit, gain 1 point of Confectance Index.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Focused Gaze
keys.effect: When this unit is under the effects of Insight, gain immunity to all displacement effects from enemy units.

keys.name: Common Key - Blessing of the Morning Star
keys.effect: ATK +3.0% / When this unit is under the effects of Insight, gains 3 tiles of Additional Movement after killing an enemy target.

keys.name: Expansion Key - Forecast Elegy
keys.effect: At the start of the turn, applies Prophecy of Mourning to the enemy with the highest HP within Attack Range
